ppu_nv_dirty.py is copied without modification from:

License: MIT (adjacent LICENSE, from the same commit).

MotorStorm calls only rewrite(..., live=False) through
tools/specialize_ppu_locals.py, with explicit locals and full reloads after
calls. The module's liveness solver, frame/memory rewrites, flag splitting,
and ABI-based nonvolatile reload rules are not used. Inputs are four pinned
function bodies; unsupported changes fail generation. The original generated
code, guest memory helpers, floating-point semantics, and macOS snapshot are
preserved. This is an iOS experiment, not an upstream SDK replacement.
